subject: Sexual Assault Awareness Month Discussion
overview: Medford Bytes host Danielle Balocca is interviewed by Chelli Keshavan in recognition of Sexual Assault Awareness Month. Balocca shares insights from her work at the Boston Area Rape Crisis Center (BARCC), discussing trauma responses, consent, intersectionality, and community prevention.

items.title: Introduction and Content Advisory
items.summary: Danielle Balocca introduces a special episode featuring an interview conducted by Chelli Keshavan regarding sexual violence, consent, and support resources.

items.title: BARCC Services and Professional Role
items.summary: Balocca outlines her role as a social worker and internship manager at the Boston Area Rape Crisis Center, detailing BARCC's counseling, medical advocacy, legal advocacy, and educational outreach services.

items.title: Understanding Sexual Violence, Trauma Responses, and Consent
items.summary: The speakers discuss the dynamics of power and control in sexual violence, debunking misconceptions about stranger assault and examining freeze-and-fawn trauma responses and enthusiastic consent.

items.title: Survivor Needs and the Criminal Legal System
items.summary: Balocca describes the immediate functional and emotional needs of survivors, contrasting empowering support models with the invasive nature of the criminal legal system.

items.title: Youth Education, Boundaries, and Sex Positivity
items.summary: The discussion covers raising children to understand bodily autonomy, distinguishing privacy from secrecy, and the need for comprehensive, sex-positive sex education.

items.title: Intersections of Race, Class, and Local Municipal Actions
items.summary: Balocca and Keshavan explore how race, income, and systemic power affect reporting and survivor experiences, alongside potential local actions for Medford businesses and municipal services.

items.title: Closing and Community Resources
items.summary: After sharing favorite local restaurants, Balocca concludes the episode with hotline information for BARCC and RAINN as well as an announcement for the annual Walk for Change.
